original_query: Have wine import amounts and volume been trending up or down during the period from 1995 to 2014?

confirmed.answer_text: Wine import amounts and volume have both been trending up from 1995 to 2014.
cited_statements: The blue bars (amounts) show an upward trend from $20 million in 1995 to over $180 million in 2014.
The orange line (volume) shows an upward trend from around 5,000 units in 1995 to over 35,000 units in 2014.
